sections.title: Mental model — one door vs two doors

blocks.md: **Stack: one door (top). Queue: two doors (back enters, front exits). Everything else is discipline.**

steps: STACK push(A) push(B) push(C) → pop returns C, then B, then A
QUEUE enqueue(A) enqueue(B) enqueue(C) → dequeue returns A, then B, then C
Both O(1) per op when built right

blocks.label: stack via vector (the easy truth)
blocks.py:
st = []
st.append(10)          # PUSH
st.append(20)
if st:
    print(st[-1])      # TOP -> 20
st.pop()               # POP

blocks.label: queue via linked list idea
blocks.py:
from collections import deque
q = deque()
q.append('A')          # enqueue back
front = q[0]           # peek front
q.popleft()            # dequeue front
